newsitem.title: UK: BFI up nine as Panamaxes remain firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up nine as Panamaxes remain firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose nine points on Tuesday to 1434 points in thin trading limited by widespread holidays.
Brokers said the panellists have marked all Panamax routes up marginally but Caper routes remained basically unchanged.
The Baltic Handy Index was returned at an unchanged 1008 points despite reports that rates for large modern modern craned vessels from the Continent are rising.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 15 to five points higher and turnover totalled 120 lots.
